description: Claude Code plugins for agent design, workflow, and tooling

plugins.name: agent-personality
plugins.description: Design personality-driven agents for Claude Code through a structured interview process. Builds capability foundations (reasoning chains, principles, worked examples), conducts 5-step personality interviews, and assembles prompts following the enriched agent MD architecture (primacy/operational/supplementary/recency zones). Creates new agents or retrofits personality onto existing ones.
